label: Season
description: Visibly distinct seasonal landscapes: blossoms, summer greenery, fall leaves, snow, thaw, wet and dry seasons.
notes: Seasonal changes in vegetation and ground cover belong here, phrased to follow “in.” scene.weather owns current atmospheric conditions, scene.time_of_day owns daily phases, and lighting.natural owns illumination. The temperate entries name visible stages rather than calendar boundaries; rainy and dry seasons cover landscapes outside the four-season pattern.

values.look: Pink and white blossoms cover tree branches above fresh green grass.
Dense green canopies and fully grown vegetation fill the landscape.
Tree canopies turn red, orange, and gold, with colorful leaves scattered below.
A continuous blanket of snow covers the ground and rests on bare branches and evergreens.
Bare branches stand above a thick carpet of brown fallen leaves and withered grass.
Melting snow survives in patches among muddy ground, meltwater, and the first green shoots.
Lush vegetation surrounds saturated ground, standing water, and swollen streams.
Bleached grasses and sparse foliage surround dusty earth and dried streambeds.
